correctness.rationale: Characteristic 17 has an irreducible quartic x^4+3 and exactly two Frobenius orbits of primitive 15th roots. Exhaustive division-free Laplace and independent exact Gaussian implementations both checked all 32767 nonempty principal minors in each orbit, zero vanishing. Theorem 1.4 in arXiv:2505.24326 then proves the exact residue-balanced complex order-255 claim. All definitions and quantifiers are specified; no finite observation was extrapolated without the published reduction.

value.rationale: The square-free Fourier-principal-minor conjecture is a genuine recovery/interpolation question. This gives a new explicit three-prime order 255 with all principal minors nonsingular and the stronger 15-balanced recovery class, outside known parameter families. Its finite certified local hypothesis is a natural exact gap enabling a nontrivial global theorem; it is not only a code or known-table recomputation.
